tasks.name: האם ראשוני?
tasks.note: Arbitrary non-arithmetic predicate on one number (lookup table), returned as a 15/0 flag.

tasks.name: הביט שבמקום ב
tasks.note: Variable-indexed bit extraction, with inputs in the unusual cells 1 and 3.

tasks.name: שורש שלם
tasks.src: a=>{ let k=0; while((k+1)*(k+1)<=a) k++; return k; }
tasks.note: Inverse of squaring found by a search loop, with the single input in cell 3.

tasks.name: השוואה עם סימן
tasks.note: Signed (two's complement) less-than where 8..15 mean -8..-1, a twist on the unsigned comparison.

tasks.name: כמה ערכים שונים
tasks.note: Equality and tie handling across three inputs: counts distinct values (1, 2 or 3).

tasks.name: סכום סדרה חשבונית
tasks.src: (a,b,c)=>{ let s=0, x=a; for(let i=0;i<c;i++){ s=(s+x)&15; x=(x+b)&15; } return s; }
tasks.note: Loop whose trip count is an input, with two accumulators: sum of c terms starting at a with step b, mod 16.

tasks.name: חציון הרשימה
tasks.src: l=>{ if(!l.length) return 0; const s=[...l].sort((a,b)=>a-b); return s[(s.length-1)>>1]; }
tasks.note: Sort, then index by a position computed from the length (lower median); empty gives 0.

tasks.name: הקטן החסר
tasks.src: l=>{ for(let v=8;v<=15;v++){ if(!l.includes(v)) return v; } return 0; }
tasks.note: Searches the value range for the smallest of 8..15 absent from the list (complement reasoning); 0 if all present.

tasks.name: סכום מתחלף
tasks.note: Position-dependent sign: l0-l1+l2-... mod 16, so order matters; empty gives 0.

tasks.name: הרצף העולה הארוך
tasks.src: l=>{ let best=0, cur=0; for(let i=0;i<l.length;i++){ cur=(i>0&&l[i]>l[i-1])?cur+1:1; if(cur>best) best=cur; } return best; }
tasks.note: Loop with a resetting counter and a running best: longest strictly increasing contiguous run anywhere; empty gives 0.

tasks.name: ערכים רצופים?
tasks.note: Compares three aggregates (max, min, length) to test whether the values form a consecutive block; empty is vacuously 15.

tasks.name: סיבוב שמאלה
tasks.note: Rotation: moves the first element to the end, keeping all elements.

tasks.name: כל איבר שני
tasks.note: Positional filter by index parity (positions 0,2,4,...), independent of the values.

tasks.name: סיבוב עד הקטן
tasks.src: l=>{ if(!l.length) return []; const i=l.indexOf(Math.min(...l)); return [...l.slice(i),...l.slice(0,i)]; }
tasks.note: Data-dependent rotation: rotates the list so that its minimum comes first, keeping cyclic order.

tasks.name: קצוות לסירוגין
tasks.src: l=>{ const r=[]; let i=0, j=l.length-1; while(i<=j){ r.push(l[i++]); if(i<=j) r.push(l[j--]); } return r; }
tasks.note: Two-pointer interleave: first, last, second, second-to-last, and so on.

tasks.name: מיון לפי שני הביטים התחתונים
tasks.note: Sort by a derived key (x mod 4) with ties broken by value, not by the value itself.
